title: AndroidManifest.xml XML comment contains illegal double hyphen: all Android builds fail
root_cause: Comment contained `--` (flutter build apk --release); XML forbids `--` in comments so ManifestMerger threw SAXParseException and every Android build failed.
proposed_fix: Reword comment to remove the `--` sequence.
verification: flutter build apk --debug exit 0; APK built (was exit 1 ManifestMerger2.MergeFailureException)

title: Truncated test file: admin customer-directory test has no main()
root_cause: File has imports/doc/mocks but no main(); dart test reports 'Missing definition of main method'; produced all 4 baseline analyzer warnings; the documented profiles.email regression was unguarded.
proposed_fix: Reconstruct main() with exact-column fetchCustomers tests and RPC-based getOrderDetails tests.
verification: 5/5 tests pass; flutter analyze clean (4 warnings removed)

title: App-lock tests never provided a Directionality ancestor (8/8 failed)
root_cause: Harness pumped AppLockGate with a raw Scaffold with no MaterialApp/Directionality ancestor; every test threw 'No Directionality widget found'.
proposed_fix: Wrap the pumped tree in MaterialApp.

title: App-lock sign-out escape caught only Exception; a thrown Error crashed the lock screen instead of staying fail-closed
root_cause: Contract: failed sign-out keeps app locked. `on Exception` did not catch Error (StateError), which escaped unawaited() as an unhandled async error and crashed the lock screen.
proposed_fix: Catch Object at the boundary, log, and return without unlocking.

title: PaymentStatusWatcher never closed its StreamController on unsubscribe
root_cause: onCancel cancelled the timer/channel but never closed the controller, so it survived until GC per payment watch.
verification: flutter analyze clean; 105 payment tests pass

title: dart format drift across 7 files (4 first-party lib files)
root_cause: Edits landed without running dart format; formatter gate red and diff noise added.
proposed_fix: Run dart format over lib and test.

title: Stale TODO claiming cached_network_image still needs adding
root_cause: TODO referenced work already delivered by ProductImageResolver/AppImage (CachedNetworkImage).
proposed_fix: Remove the TODO; point to where caching lives.
verification: flutter analyze clean; storefront tests pass

title: Admin customer directory filtered by RLS because the referenced 061 policy migration does not exist
root_cause: profiles grants SELECT only for auth.uid()=id, so the directory shows only the caller's row; no leak, but silent under-reporting. Referenced proposal file was absent.
proposed_fix: Ship review-gated SQL proposal adding an admin-only SELECT policy (SECURITY DEFINER helper).
verification: Owner chose route (a); supabase/migrations/061_admin_profiles_read.sql now exists with provenance notes. Not applied to any DB (config.toml pinned to production-parity ref) - apply on staging and verify the admin Customers list.

title: Unpinned dependency constraint `http: any` in dev_dependencies
root_cause: `any` accepts future majors; a fresh pub get can pull breaking releases and bypasses the repo's pinning discipline.
proposed_fix: Pin to ^1.2.0 or remove if unused.
verification: pubspec.yaml pins http: ^1.2.0; gates re-proven on the merge head (analyze 0, 888/888, APK builds)

title: Documented TODO requires a schema field to resolve (catalog colour names)
root_cause: catalogColorName maps hardcoded ARGB ints; the fix needs a Product.colorName column (DB decision).
proposed_fix: Add products.color_name / lookup table and read via mapper, keeping the 'Other' fallback.

title: Hardcoded English strings in the admin console and invoice PDF
root_cause: Admin console and invoice document deliberately bypass l10n (documented inline).
proposed_fix: Add ARB keys + context.l10n if Arabic-speaking staff use the console; invoice PDF needs locale plumbing.
verification: Inline comments confirm intent; storefront/user-facing copy fully localized

title: .gitignore lists lib/generated/ while those generated l10n files are tracked
root_cause: Ignore rules cannot apply to tracked files; the contradiction may surprise contributors.
proposed_fix: Document the exception next to the rule or add !lib/generated/l10n/.

title: Tracked staging config contains a real committed Supabase anon JWT
root_cause: Repo convention (per .gitignore) is that committed templates hold placeholders and real values live in gitignored *.local.json. env.production.json honours it; env.staging.json held a genuine 208-char JWT (role=anon) introduced by d50a181. Anon keys are public-by-design and RLS-gated, so no direct exploit path - the risks are the broken convention and dependence on RLS completeness.
proposed_fix: Replace the tracked value with a placeholder, keep the real key in config/env.staging.local.json, and rotate the staging anon key since it is in git history.
verification: Verified: tracked template now holds a 29-char REPLACE_ placeholder (0 non-ASCII bytes). REMAINING: rotate the key in the Supabase dashboard - the old value is still in git history.

title: Corrupt/unsorted .git/packed-refs breaks git clone of the repository
root_cause: packed-refs was unsorted (packedRefUnsorted) and the same ref also existed as a loose ref with a different SHA, so git reported 'multiple updates for ref'. Fresh clones, CI checkouts and new worktrees failed. Discovered by the audit, not caused by it.
proposed_fix: Back up .git/packed-refs, resolve which SHA is the real audit-remediation tip, remove the duplicate/stale definition, re-sort the file, then git pack-refs --all and git fsck --full.
verification: Owner removed the stale duplicate (kept tip 447f645, backup at .git/packed-refs.bak); auditor verified git show-ref lists the ref once and git clone --local --no-hardlinks exits 0
